### Permutation test against captured non-significant heads

H0: a CMA-significant head's attention is exchangeable with that of any other captured head in the same cell. Each of the 5000 draws swaps the significant rows of every cell for non-significant rows of that cell and reuses the observed weights; p is one-sided (upper), add-one corrected. Conservative: the top-50 capture pool is itself CMA-enriched.
